translation: concluyen las oraciones de ⟨el⟩ David ⟨hijo⟩ ⟨de⟩ Yesai

tokens.rationale: The root כלה means to end, finish, or be completed; here in the כלו form indicating the prayers are finished/concluded
From תפלה (prayer), here in plural construct form meaning 'prayers of'
The Hebrew בן (son) is omitted in English when it's part of a patronymic construction
Canonical form for Jesse, David's father
